stem.text: Eukaryotic organisms grow and increase in size as a result of cell division. The diagram shows some stages of mitosis with one stage missing, labelled X.

stem.alt: Two photographs of dividing cells, with an arrow labelled X between them.

A.text: Spindle fibres attach to the centromeres and the chromosomes line up along the equator.

B.text: The chromatin coils and condenses and the nuclear membrane disintegrates.

C.text: The chromosomes line up in pairs along the equator of the cell.

D.text: Microtubules shorten so that spindle fibres contract and the centromeres divide.
